title: EnrichmentPathContentConflict
description: Content-addressing decision record for the enrichment cache. Classifies whether a filesystem observation change should trigger re-enrichment. The key insight: asset_hash (content) is the enrichment cache key, not the path. A file move with the same content hash is a no-op for enrichment; a content change on any path requires re-enrichment. See enrichment-twin-mission-spec.md §6.

conflict_kind.description: Canonical conflict classification. no_change and path_moved_content_same never trigger re-enrichment. All others do.

re_enrich_required.description: True iff the enrichment cache entry for this asset must be invalidated and re-computed.

cache_key_changed.description: True iff the cache key (asset_hash, analyzer_version, model_version) changed. Always matches re_enrich_required for content-driven changes.

path.description: Filesystem path at time of observation. Path is informational only — it is NOT the cache key.

asset_hash.description: SHA-256 of asset content. This IS the cache key for enrichment.
